surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of trimethylaluminum (TMA) and tris(isopropylcyclopentadienyl) lanthanum [La(iPrCp)3] precursors followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. The La precursor pulse time and oxidant pulse time influence the formation of La-Al-O bonds and the reduction of La-hydroxide and La-silicate formation.
evidence: The text discusses the surface reactions involving the adsorption of TMA and La(iPrCp)3 precursors, followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. It mentions the formation of La-Al-O bonds, La-OH, La-Si-O, Al-O-Al, and La-O-La as intermediate species during the ALD process.
